payload.description_html: Mounted skeletons of Allosaurus anax and Apatosaurus sp. in the Oklahoma Museum of Natural History. The latter dinosaur may be closer to the actual fossils the name Saurophaganax is based on. The human in the background for scale is the american paleontologist Matt Wedel.
